description: Scaffold the Astro project foundation: package.json, all config files, folder structure, move assets, install dependencies. This is the prerequisite for every other FEAT — nothing else can build until npm install succeeds.
steps: 1. Create root package.json with scripts (dev, build, preview), Astro 5 as main dependency, and all required deps: astro@^5, @astrojs/react@^4, @astrojs/tailwind@^5, @astrojs/sitemap@^3, react@^18, react-dom@^18, motion@^11, @sanity/client@^6, @sanity/image-url@^1, tailwindcss@^3, typescript@^5. Exact versions pinned to avoid drift. File: package.json
2. Create tsconfig.json with strict mode, JSX preserve for Astro, paths alias @/* -> src/*, and include src/**/* and studio/**/*. File: tsconfig.json

3. Create astro.config.mjs importing defineConfig from astro, react() from @astrojs/react, tailwind() from @astrojs/tailwind, sitemap() from @astrojs/sitemap. Set output: 'static', site: 'https://ahmedesseketcom.pages.dev', integrations array. File: astro.config.mjs

4. Create tailwind.config.mjs with content glob covering src/**/*.{astro,tsx,ts,js}, extend theme with: fontFamily (display: ['Pr_1', 'sans-serif'], body: ['Pr_2', 'sans-serif']), colors (accent: '#E8FF00', dark: '#0A0A0A', surface: '#111111'), and screen breakpoints. File: tailwind.config.mjs

5. Create src/styles/global.css with @tailwind base/components/utilities, @font-face declarations for Pr_1.ttf (font-family: 'Pr_1') and Pr_2.ttf (font-family: 'Pr_2'), CSS custom properties for the design tokens (--color-accent, --color-dark, --color-surface), and base body styles (bg-dark, text-white). File: src/styles/global.css
6. Create all required directories: src/assets/fonts/, src/assets/images/, src/components/react/, src/components/blocks/, src/layouts/, src/lib/, src/pages/projects/, public/

7. Copy (do NOT delete yet) the workspace-root assets into their new homes: Hero_Chrome_1.png -> src/assets/images/, Hero_Chrome_2.png -> src/assets/images/, Hero_Chrome_3.png -> src/assets/images/, Pr_1.ttf -> src/assets/fonts/, Pr_2.ttf -> src/assets/fonts/. Use PowerShell Copy-Item. After verifying npm run build succeeds in a later FEAT, the originals at root can remain (they are ignored by Astro).
8. Create .env.example with placeholders: PUBLIC_SANITY_PROJECT_ID=your_project_id, PUBLIC_SANITY_DATASET=production, SANITY_API_TOKEN=your_token. File: .env.example
9. Create .gitignore covering: node_modules/, dist/, .astro/, .env, studio/node_modules/, studio/.sanity/. File: .gitignore
10. Create public/robots.txt with User-agent: * / Allow: /. File: public/robots.txt
11. Run: npm install from workspace root to install all dependencies.

astro.config.mjs, tailwind.config.mjs, tsconfig.json all exist and are valid JS/JSON
